newsitem.title: FRANCE: AXA to pre-pay 6.0 pct convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: AXA to pre-pay 6.0 pct convertible bond.

text.p: AXA said it was going to repay early a six percent 1993-2001 convertible bond for a total of 3.65 billion francs on February 14.
It said in a statement that holders of the bonds can on February 14 either decide to convert their bonds until May 14 into AXA shares, at a rate of 5.15 shares for one bond.
From May 15, all holders of non converted bonds will receive 1,285 francs per bond plus 9.29 francs in interest.
If all the bonds were converted it would make a positive impact on the 1997 net consolidated result of 180 million francs, of which 133 million in lower interest costs.
AXA added its shareholders funds would rise by 3.489 billion francs while its debt would diminish with the same amount.
